verdict.rationale: Chronicle accepts trace telemetry from your own code, from agent tool calls, or from an OpenTelemetry exporter, which can be queried in Timeline or via the SDK. Agent keys carry a traces:write scope, and observability shows every request, change, and score. However, nothing in the evidence explicitly documents nested span hierarchies or grouping runs into sessions or threads. Missing for 10: documented nested/parent-child span model, session or thread grouping of multi-step runs, trace data model/API reference, hands-on or independent corroboration.
